KBC Sunday LGBTQIA+ Allies Ride

Kalamazoo, MI · Road · Social

LGBTQ+No-dropBeginner friendly

KBC Sunday LGBTQIA+ Allies Ride is a road and social group ride in Kalamazoo, MI. It rolls every Sunday at 10:00 am from Rotates: 1st Sun Celery Flats (7328 Garden Ln, Portage); 2nd Sun Texas Drive Park (6603 Texas Dr, Kalamazoo); 3rd Sun Oshtemo Grange Hall (3234 N 3rd St); 4th Sun Kindleberger Park (Parchment). Pace: all abilities. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all abilities. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the KBC Sunday LGBTQIA+ Allies Ride group ride

A no-drop club ride for LGBTQIA+ riders and allies. All abilities welcome. Starts rotate between four parks through the month. Helmets required, lights encouraged.
